8-Day Turkey Express Tour: Istanbul to Ephesus
summary:
The 8-Day Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus & Pamukkale Tour connects four of Turkey’s best-known regions without spending unnecessary days in transit. Explore Istanbul’s historic Sultanahmet district and Bosphorus, then fly to Cappadocia for its valleys, fairy chimneys and underground cities. Continue west to walk through ancient Ephesus before visiting Pamukkale’s white travertine terraces and the nearby ruins of Hierapolis.
Choose the travel dates that suit your plans, with itinerary adjustments available when needed. We arrange selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, three domestic flights, airport transfers, entrance fees and the sightseeing included in the program.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise & Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. Transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, meet your driver and transfer to hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Ürgüp and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia Tour & Flight to Izmir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir at 22:50. Upon arrival at 00:20, meet and transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Ephesus Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, one of the best-preserved ancient cities in the world. Enter through the Magnesia Gate and walk past remarkable landmarks including the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the impressive Great Theatre, where Saint Paul once preached. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. After lunch, visit the sacred House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale Tour & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces, known as the “Cotton Castle,” and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, transfer to Denizli Airport for your flight to Istanbul at 21:15. Upon arrival at 22:35, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors?
faqs.a: Yes. This itinerary is designed especially for first-time visitors to Turkey, covering Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus, and Pamukkale in one well-planned journey. It combines the country's most famous historical sites, natural wonders, and cultural experiences while minimizing travel time with domestic flights.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 8 Day Turkey Classic Tour?
faqs.a: This tour visits four of Turkey's most iconic destinations: Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus, and Pamukkale. You'll explore UNESCO World Heritage Sites, ancient cities, unique landscapes, and vibrant local culture, creating a balanced introduction to Turkey's rich history, nature, and traditions.

faqs.q: How much does the 8 Day Turkey Classic Tour cost?
faqs.a: Tour prices vary depending on your travel dates, hotel category, and group size. The website displays the current starting price, and we will provide a personalized quotation based on your preferred departure date and accommodation requirements.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this 8-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes. All required domestic flights within Turkey are included, helping reduce long travel times between destinations. Airport transfers are also provided, ensuring a comfortable and seamless travel experience throughout your journey from arrival until departure.

faqs.q: What is included in the tour price?
faqs.a: The tour includes accommodation, domestic flights, airport transfers, guided sightseeing, entrance fees, transportation, and meals as specified in the itinerary. All services are clearly listed on the tour page, ensuring transparent pricing with no hidden costs.

faqs.q: What is not included in the tour price?
faqs.a: International flights, travel insurance, personal expenses, beverages, optional activities, tips, and meals not mentioned in the itinerary are not included. We recommend reviewing the detailed inclusions and exclusions section before confirming your reservation.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: This tour requires a moderate level of fitness. Most sightseeing involves comfortable walking through historical sites, museums, and uneven ancient pathways. It is suitable for most travelers who can walk independently and enjoy full-day sightseeing activities.

faqs.q: Can I add a hot air balloon ride in Cappadocia?
faqs.a: Yes. The Cappadocia hot air balloon ride is available as an optional activity and can be added during booking. We recommend reserving early, especially during peak travel seasons, as availability is limited and weather conditions may affect flights.

Yes. This tour can be customized to match your travel preferences, schedule, and budget. We can upgrade hotels, add extra nights, include private guided tours, adjust sightseeing, or extend your itinerary with destinations such as Antalya, Fethiye, or the Turkish Riviera.

faqs.q: Is the tour available all year round?
faqs.a: Yes. This tour operates throughout the year with daily departures, subject to availability. Every season offers a different travel experience, from spring flowers and autumn colors to snowy Cappadocia landscapes and vibrant summer sightseeing opportunities.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 8 Day Turkey Classic Tour?
faqs.a: Our cancellation policy depends on the notice period before departure and services already confirmed, including flights and hotels. Full details are available in our booking conditions, and we recommend reviewing them before confirming your reservation.

faqs.q: How do I book this tour?
faqs.a: Simply complete the online inquiry or booking form on our website, and our travel specialists will confirm availability, answer your questions, and send your personalized itinerary, quotation, and booking instructions before your reservation is finalized.
